title: Add first-launch onboarding modal with instructions

requirements.text: Add a first-launch onboarding modal that automatically opens the first time a user opens the app in a given browser and presents the app usage + Gumroad/Etsy upload instructions inside the app.

quotes: Everything is in place — would you like to add a short onboarding modal so users see the instructions right inside the app when they first open it?

acceptanceCriteria: On first app load in a fresh browser profile, an onboarding modal opens automatically without requiring navigation to the Export screen.
The modal content is in English and reuses the existing instructions content (the same guidance users can see in the app) rather than introducing conflicting steps.
Closing the modal persists a local flag (e.g., localStorage) so the modal does not auto-open again on subsequent visits in the same browser.
The modal can be dismissed via a clearly labeled Close button; pressing Escape also closes it (standard dialog behavior).

requirements.text: Ensure the onboarding modal does not block required first-time profile setup: if the profile setup dialog is shown (authenticated user with no profile), show profile setup first; only show the onboarding modal after profile setup is complete or if profile setup is not needed.
acceptanceCriteria: When ProfileSetupDialog is open, the onboarding modal is not shown at the same time.
After profile setup completes, the onboarding modal appears if it has not been dismissed previously in that browser.

requirements.text: Provide a persistent way for users to re-open the onboarding instructions modal after dismissing it (for example, a header link/button labeled "Instructions" or "Help").
acceptanceCriteria: A user can re-open the onboarding modal from the main app UI at any time (both from the editor view and export view).
Re-opening the modal does not reset the 'seen' flag; the modal still does not auto-open on future app loads unless the user manually opens it.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or anything in frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Do not add or modify backend canister APIs for onboarding state (store onboarding state locally in the browser only).
Do not change the existing Export screen instructions content beyond what is necessary to embed/reuse it in the onboarding modal.
